universe_definition: 9 pre-event trading days 20261014...20261028 with continuous valid close; >=20m TWD mean prior daily traded value; >=2m every day; 20261007 price available

scoring.algorithm: Cross-sectional ranks among prior-date eligible stocks only; reverse rank of priorVolPct 50%, direct rank priorWorstDayPct 30%, direct rank priorTrendPct 20%

measurement.priorVolPct: population standard deviation of eight prior close-to-close daily returns (20261014-20261028)
measurement.priorWorstDayPct: minimum of 8 prior daily returns (higher/less negative is better)

limitations: Weights selected after reviewing the same episode, not out-of-time validated, no forward trading claims
Corporate actions, industry beta, sector allocation and carry not controlled
Research universe defined before the episode without future liquidity filter; only endpoint existence for observed performance
Historical five-day relative beat frequencies are NOT prospective accuracy or success probabilities
Score is cross-sectional rank conditional on one date and universe, not a calibrated risk probability
